spc_hotelling_t2 — SPC multivariate op

• 数据种类:matrix → table

• 调用: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.spc_hotelling_t2(data, alpha=0.0027, mean=None, cov=None)(要直接调用实现,import spc; spc.spc_hotelling_t2(data, alpha=0.0027, mean=None, cov=None);从台账取用则 opsspc.get("spc_hotelling_t2"))

• GPU:无(仅 CPU 参考实现)

用法

基于 Hotelling T² 的多变量 SPC，控制限按所处阶段选取(第 I 阶段用 Beta 分布，参数已知时用 χ² 分布)。

> 以下的详细说明为原文 —— 摘要与标题已翻译。

data is a 2-D array of shape (m, p) — m observations of p correlated features. Each row's statistic is::

T^2_i = (x_i - mu)' S^-1 (x_i - mu)

The control limit depends on where mu and S come from, and the op picks it from what you pass:

• Phase I (default, neither mean nor cov) — mu and S are the sample mean and ddof=1 covariance of the *same* rows. Then m T^2_i / (m-1)^2 follows Beta(p/2, (m-p-1)/2) exactly (Gnanadesikan & Kettenring 1972; Tracy, Young & Mason 1992), so::

UCL = (m-1)^2 / m * Beta_{1-alpha}(p/2, (m-p-1)/2)

In phase I T^2_i <= (m-1)^2/m holds for every row whatever the data, so

the phase-II F limit (which exceeds that bound for small m) can never

alarm there. Needs m >= p + 2.

• Known parameters (both mean and cov) — the in-control mean and covariance are taken as known (a specification, or estimates from a very large reference). Then T^2 ~ chi^2_p and UCL = chi^2_{p, 1-alpha}, independent of how many rows are charted (one row is enough).

• Phase II with estimated parameters — if mean / cov were estimated from a separate in-control reference of n rows and new rows are charted against them, the exact limit is p (n+1)(n-1) / (n (n-p)) * F_{1-alpha}(p, n-p) with n the size of the *reference*, not of the charted data. This op treats passed parameters as known (chi-square limit, the n -> inf limit of that F form); for a small reference compute the F limit with your n and compare t2 against it.

Passing only one of mean / cov is refused: no standard control limit exists for a half-known parameter set.

At false-alarm rate alpha (default 0.0027, the 3-sigma-equivalent). Returns a dict with the per-row t2 array, the ucl, the phase used ("phase_I" / "known"), the integer indices out_of_control, and boolean in_control. The mean row (x == mu) has T^2 == 0 (pinned in the tests).

Raises ValueError: a non-2-D / empty *data*, fewer than p+2 observations in phase I, only one of mean / cov, alpha outside (0, 1), a singular covariance, or non-finite / mislabelled input.
